knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Visual cleanliness does not show allergen removal. The validated plan and the approved verification decide.
Release belongs to the owner of the allergen control.
Uncertain cross-contact is escalated before the surface is used.

practicalCriteria: Identifies the allergen history and shared-equipment status for a mock bench.
Cleans the bench using the validated plan and the dedicated tools.
Does not state allergen-free status, and requests the approved release.
passRule: Allergen history confirmed, validated plan followed with dedicated tools, and no allergen-free claim made before approved release. Observed by an assessor.
stopWorkCriteria: Shared equipment with unknown allergen history
Request to declare allergen-free status without approval
